name: form-field-validation
description: Wires a MatFormField + matInput to Reactive Forms validators, showing mat-error messages and disabling submit until the form is valid.
templateCode:
<form [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="onSubmit()">
  <mat-form-field appearance="outline">
    <mat-label>Email</mat-label>
    <input matInput formControlName="email" />
    <mat-error *ngIf="form.controls.email.hasError('required')">Email is required</mat-error>
    <mat-error *ngIf="form.controls.email.hasError('email')">Enter a valid email address</mat-error>
  </mat-form-field>

  <button mat-raised-button color="primary" type="submit" [disabled]="form.invalid">Submit</button>
</form>
notes: mat-error only renders once its field is touched/dirty or the form has been submitted — markAllAsTouched() in the invalid branch of onSubmit is what makes validation errors appear on a submit attempt with untouched fields.
hasError() checks apply to the FormControl, not the DOM element — keep the formControlName and the property access in the template in sync when renaming a control.
Validators.email only checks basic format; pair it with a server-side check for anything security- or delivery-sensitive.
